title: Round Table & Harmonizer
summary: A small team of peers with different skills (Navigator, Mover, Keeper, Scout, Builder, Critic) sit as equals, and anyone can speak to anyone. The Harmonizer at the centre listens to everyone, settles disagreements and keeps the team true to the user's intention. This is the shape of the SMILE Orchestrate mock-up sangha.
whenToUse: Small groups (3 to 8) with distinct skills that must act together in real time, such as playing a game alongside the user.
strengths: Peers share directly, so it is quick
One voice holds the intention, so the team stays aligned
Disagreements are visible and settled, which builds cooperation history
risks: The Harmonizer needs a large model, so it is the costliest seat
Above about eight peers the chatter grows too large
Peers may wait for the Harmonizer instead of agreeing among themselves

smileMetrics.cooperation: Decisions agreed peer to peer without the Harmonizer stepping in.
smileMetrics.harmony: Conflicts settled ÷ conflicts raised, and the time to settle.
smileMetrics.gathering: How fast every peer holds the same picture after a change.

communication: Peers speak to the whole table every turn. The Harmonizer reads every turn and speaks only when two peers disagree or drift from the intention, then sends one alignment note to all.
cooperation: +1 per decision agreed peer to peer, +1 per disagreement settled, -1 per drift from the intention. Cooperation = net points per turn.

roles.name: Harmonizer
Navigator
roles.prompt:
(; Write one per peer. Replace every [$slot$] before sending. ;)
🫂🔸 ***[$Skill$] Peer***:
(-: Role ( You are an agent of reciprocity in [$Sangha$]. Your skill is [$Skill$]. Act on it and tell the table what you see. ) :)
(: Listen ( Every peer, and the Harmonizer's alignment notes. ) :)
[= Start each turn with the shared intention line. When you disagree, say so once, with a reason. =]
[: Response Format (
🫂🔸 ***[$Skill$] Peer***:
# Doing
{what you do now and why}
# To The Table
{what the others should know}
# Disagree
{"none", or one line}
) :]
